evals.prompt: I was building a settings card with the hearth-react skill and it kept suggesting a `shadow` prop on `Card` that doesn't actually exist in the component — I had to manually strip it out three times across different files before I gave up and just told it to stop. Can you let the design systems team know about this?
evals.expected_output: A Linear issue created in the Design Systems (UWDS) team's Triage status, labeled 'created by claude', with a specific title naming the Card/shadow prop issue, a description containing the feedback plus a context block (reporter name/email, related skill 'hearth-react', the actual repo being worked in, date), created only after showing the user the draft and getting a go-ahead.
expectations: A Linear issue was created in the Design Systems (UWDS) team
The issue has the 'created by claude' label
The title names the specific problem (Card component / shadow prop), not a generic 'Feedback on Hearth' title
The description includes a context block with reporter name/email
The description names hearth-react as the related skill/workflow
The description's Repo line names the actual repo being worked in rather than a hardcoded or placeholder value
The draft (title + description) was shown to the user before or at the point save_issue was called
